title: MLOps Personality Classification Project
summary: A student MLOps pipeline for personality-type classification that adds DVC data versioning, MLflow tracking, drift monitoring, and a Gradio deployment interface. Its data_synthetic_generator.py imports SDV's single-table CTGANSynthesizer to fit on the original personality dataset and sample synthetic augmentation data, falling back to statistical sampling if SDV is unavailable.
evidence: data_synthetic_generator.py:179 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100, verbose=False); synthesizer.fit(...); synthesizer.sample(...)'
